request.subject: ICON:ACTION:STOMP

layers.text: Redraw it as a different object in the same style: one huge round grey dinosaur foot with three blunt cream toenails stamping straight down onto cracked tawny ground, a ring of dust puffs and small rocks bursting out on both sides and two short white shock lines. Nothing else: no head, no horns. Thick dark outline, flat colours, on a transparent background.
